goal: Prevent node assertion crashes and integer overflows when wallet transaction creation receives huge amounts
Reject recipient amounts and totals exceeding the maximum money limit before coin selection
agreement: Substantive support as a helpful sanity check and improvement for sanitizers (maflcko)
Loop refactoring feedback addressed and incorporated (furszy, maflcko)
Nonblocking suggestion to close other PRs and focus on one to avoid review fatigue (pinheadmz)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes node crashes and overflow bugs caused by amounts exceeding maximum money
Triggering the bug requires an authenticated RPC caller to provide invalid out-of-range amounts
